reason: E1 states that IrOsPtPdRhRu catalyzes a 12-electron ethanol oxidation while single metals do at most a 4-electron process, and that neighboring active sites in HEAs can tune selectivity, supporting the premises about pathway and ensemble effects. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that Pt–Pt ensembles specifically cause CO_ads formation or that diluting them suppresses CO_ads and enhances selectivity; these mechanistic claims are not directly supported by the cited passages.
premises: Pt–Pt contiguous sites promote CO_ads formation during ethanol oxidation
Diluting Pt ensembles suppresses CO_ads and favors a 12-electron pathway
IrOsPtPdRhRu HEA catalyzes ethanol oxidation via a 12-electron process
Single platinum-group metals typically catalyze only a 4-electron ethanol oxidation
Local atomic ensemble configuration in HEAs can tune reaction selectivity
